title: The Fisherman: Bobby Fischer (Stockfish waited for one man)
post: Stockfish waited for one man to die 🎣 #chess #bobbyfischer #stockfish #story

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: This fish is rated 3650. And it waited until one man was dead.
phrases.say: [serious] This fish is rated thirty-six fifty. [pause] And it waited... until one man was dead.

phrases.text: Bobby Fischer. In German, Fischer means fisherman.
phrases.say: Bobby Fischer. [pause] In German, Fischer means... [intense] fisherman.

phrases.text: While he was alive, no big fish was safe.
phrases.say: While he was alive... no big fish was safe.

phrases.text: At fourteen, champion of America. At fifteen, the youngest grandmaster on Earth.
phrases.say: At fourteen, champion of America. At fifteen... the youngest grandmaster on Earth.

phrases.text: Eleven games, eleven wins. Nobody has done it since.
phrases.say: Eleven games, eleven wins. [pause] Nobody has done it since.

phrases.text: Then he went for the deep sea. The Soviets had held the world title for 24 years.
phrases.say: Then he went for the deep sea. [tense] The Soviets had held the world title for twenty-four years.

phrases.text: He beat the best players in the world twenty times in a row.
phrases.say: He beat the best players in the world... [intense] twenty times in a row.

phrases.text: Taimanov: 6–0. His own country took his salary. Larsen: 6–0.
phrases.say: Taimanov: six, zero. His own country took his salary. [pause] Larsen: six, zero.

phrases.text: 1972. World champion Spassky. After game six, even he applauded.
phrases.say: Nineteen seventy-two. World champion Spassky. [pause] After game six... [awed] even he applauded.

phrases.text: His rating: 125 above number two. Magnus never got that far ahead.
phrases.say: His rating: a hundred and twenty-five above number two. [pause] Magnus never got that far ahead.

phrases.text: In 1977, he played a computer. Three games, three wins.
phrases.say: In nineteen seventy-seven, he played a computer. [smug] Three games... three wins.
[softly] He died in January, two thousand eight.

phrases.text: That same year, the fish finally dared to surface.
phrases.say: That same year... [whispers] the fish finally dared to surface.
Stockfish: thirty-six fifty. Fischer: twenty-seven eighty-five. [curious] What's yours?
